title: MetaVul: Agentic Harness Discovery for Vulnerability Detection
title_zh: MetaVul：面向漏洞检测的智能体框架发现

paragraphs.en: MetaVul通过自改进优化循环发现漏洞检测智能体框架，成对检测准确率最多提升25.8个百分点。 LLM agents are increasingly used to automate vulnerability detection, but reliable detection is challenging because agents must distinguish subtle, security-relevant fixes from benign code variation. While underlying LLM capability has improved significantly, the accuracy of the agent still depends heavily on the harness: the code that defines the scaffolding around the LLM. Harnesses are typically fixed, and largely hand-written, limiting adaptation to evaluator feedback. Additionally, when harnesses are static, improvements on one dataset or model may not transfer to others. To address these challenges, we introduce MetaVul, a self-improving framework for harness discovery in vulnerability detection. Starting from a seed structured reasoning scaffold, MetaVul uses a workflow-based optimization loop to iteratively refine the harness using feedback from paired vulnerable and patched functions, while preserving the structured reasoning and verdict format. At each iteration, it searches over the history of prior harnesses, with access to their trajectories, logs, and metrics, and it returns a set of Pareto-optimal harnesses. We apply MetaVul to discover agent harnesses for various architectures. A validation set (202 pairs) is used for optimization, while an unseen dataset (430 pairs) is kept as the held-out set. We test whether harnesses learned from one model transfer to others not seen during optimization. Results on both frontier and small LLMs show that the optimized harnesses improve pairwise vulnerability detection up to 23.3 percentage points on the validation set and up to 25.8 points on the held-out set with a Pareto-frontier harness. Harnesses learned with one model also transfer to others. We show that harnesses optimized with one model transfer to another, improving held-out pairwise accuracy by 14.7 points without further optimization.
paragraphs.zh: MetaVul通过自改进优化循环发现漏洞检测智能体框架，成对检测准确率最多提升25.8个百分点。大语言模型智能体越来越多地被用于自动化漏洞检测，但可靠的检测具有挑战性，因为智能体必须将细微的、与安全相关的修复与良性的代码变更区分开来。 尽管底层大语言模型的能力已显著提升，但智能体的准确率仍在很大程度上取决于框架（harness）：即定义大语言模型周围脚手架结构的代码。 框架通常是固定的，且大多为手写，这限制了对评估者反馈的适应能力。 此外，当框架是静态的时，在一个数据集或模型上的改进可能无法迁移到其他数据集或模型。 为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MetaVul，一个用于漏洞检测框架发现的自改进框架。 从一个种子结构化推理脚手架出发，MetaVul使用基于工作流的优化循环，利用来自成对易受攻击函数与已修补函数的反馈迭代地改进框架，同时保留结构化推理和判定格式。 在每次迭代中，它搜索先前框架的历史记录，可以访问这些框架的轨迹、日志和指标，并返回一组帕累托最优的框架。 我们将MetaVul应用于为各种架构发现智能体框架。 一个验证集（202对）用于优化，而一个未见过的数据集（430对）作为保留测试集。 我们测试从一个模型学到的框架能否迁移到优化过程中未见过的其他模型。 在前沿大语言模型和小型大语言模型上的结果表明，优化后的框架在验证集上将成对漏洞检测准确率最多提升23.3个百分点，在使用帕累托前沿框架时在保留测试集上最多提升25.8个百分点。 用一个模型学到的框架也能迁移到其他模型。 我们展示了用一个模型优化的框架可以迁移到另一个模型，在无需进一步优化的情况下将保留测试集的成对准确率提升14.7个百分点。
